exerciseVideos.title: 10-Minute Night Shift Wake-Up Stretch
exerciseVideos.description: A gentle full-body stretch routine to do immediately after waking from a night shift, designed to ease stiffness and activate circulation without spiking cortisol.
instructions: Start lying flat — take 5 deep belly breaths before moving.
Hug both knees to chest, hold 30 seconds.
Drop knees side to side for spinal rotation — 10 reps each side.
Cat-cow on all fours — 10 slow repetitions.
Child's pose — hold 45 seconds, breathe deeply.
Neck rolls — 5 each direction, keep it slow.
Standing forward fold — hang for 30 seconds.
Finish with 3 deep breaths and a glass of water.

exerciseVideos.title: 20-Minute HIIT for Night Workers
exerciseVideos.description: High-intensity interval training timed for your alertness window — 3–5 hours after waking. No equipment needed.
instructions: Warm up: 90 seconds of marching on the spot.
Round 1: Jump squats × 45 sec, rest 15 sec.
Round 2: Push-up to shoulder tap × 45 sec, rest 15 sec.
Round 3: High knees × 45 sec, rest 15 sec.
Round 4: Reverse lunges alternating × 45 sec, rest 15 sec.
Round 5: Burpees × 45 sec, rest 15 sec.
Repeat rounds 1–5 twice more.
Cool down: 3 minutes walking, then static stretches.

exerciseVideos.title: Yoga for Better Sleep
exerciseVideos.description: A wind-down yoga flow to activate the parasympathetic nervous system. Do this 60–90 minutes before your sleep window.
instructions: Begin in Corpse Pose (Savasana) — settle for 2 minutes.
Legs up the wall (Viparita Karani) — stay for 5 minutes.
Seated forward fold — 10 breaths.
Butterfly pose — 2 minutes.
Supine spinal twist — 90 seconds each side.
Bridge pose — hold 30 seconds × 3.
Return to Savasana for 5 minutes of box breathing.
Set your sleep intention and move directly to bed.

exerciseVideos.title: 5-Minute Meditation: Shift Worker Reset
exerciseVideos.description: A short guided meditation to decompress between shifts. Ideal after a long night before attempting to sleep.
instructions: Sit or lie comfortably in a quiet, dimly lit space.
Close your eyes and take 3 sighing exhales.
Follow the guided body scan — release tension from face, shoulders, hands, legs.
Breath awareness: count breaths 1–10, restart when your mind wanders.
Visualise a calm, safe space — your personal reset anchor.
End with an intention for your upcoming sleep.

nutritionVideos.title: 5-Minute Overnight Oats
nutritionVideos.description: Prep before your night shift for a ready-made, nutritious breakfast when you wake. High in slow-release carbohydrates and protein.
instructions: Add ½ cup rolled oats to a jar or container.
Pour in ½ cup milk or oat milk.
Add 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for protein.
Stir in 1 tsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Top with berries or sliced banana.
Seal and refrigerate — ready in the morning.
Optional: add a scoop of protein powder for extra fuel.

nutritionVideos.title: Shift Worker's Power Bowl
nutritionVideos.description: A filling, balanced lunch ready in under 15 minutes. Anti-inflammatory ingredients to reduce the oxidative stress shift work causes.
instructions: Cook ½ cup brown rice (use a microwave pack for speed).
Drain and rinse a tin of chickpeas; pan-fry 3 minutes with olive oil, cumin, and paprika.
Chop half a cucumber, a handful of cherry tomatoes, and ¼ red onion.
Wilt a large handful of spinach in a pan — 60 seconds.
Assemble: rice base, chickpeas, vegetables, spinach.
Drizzle with tahini thinned with lemon juice and a splash of water.
Season with salt, pepper, chilli flakes.

nutritionVideos.title: One-Pan Salmon & Greens
nutritionVideos.description: High omega-3 dinner that supports melatonin production and reduces night shift inflammation. On the table in 20 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line a tray with baking paper.
Place salmon fillets on tray; season with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Toss broccolini and asparagus in olive oil; season and place around salmon.
Roast 15–18 minutes until salmon is cooked through.
Squeeze lemon over everything.
Optional: serve with a microwave pouch of quinoa.

nutritionVideos.title: Night Shift Snack Box Prep
nutritionVideos.description: Prep a week's worth of healthy shift snacks in one go. Prevents vending machine disasters at 3am.
instructions: Hard boil 6 eggs — 9 minutes, then ice bath. Peel and portion.
Slice capsicum, celery, and cucumber into sticks; portion into bags.
Divide hummus (100g per snack) into small containers.
Measure mixed nuts and dark chocolate pieces into snack bags (30g each).
Portion Greek yogurt into small jars; top with granola.
Store in fridge — grab a box before each shift.
Avoid high-sugar snacks — they cause 3am energy crashes.
